This winter, Minnesotans showed the world what courage looks like—now the people of the Twin Cities will be honored with the John F. Kennedy Profile in Courage Award.

From helping neighbors to marching 50,000 strong, this recognition reflects the best of our state and country.

Video

We introduced a Senate resolution to honor Master Sgt. Nicole Amor's memory and sacrifice. A devoted mother of two, she served our country for 20 years and was a beloved member of her community.

The Blatnik Bridge is critical to our economy and a vital link for workers, families, and businesses. That is why I worked across the aisle and with two states and with two administrations to secure the needed funding and move this project forward as quickly as possible.

Video

The SAVE America Act makes it harder for American citizens to vote.

It hands private voter data over to DHS and adds costly hurdles just to register.

We should be making it easier for Americans to have their voices heard and have their right to vote — not harder.

New York Times headline: “Striking Down Pentagon Press Limits, Judge Vindicates Independent Journalism”

The Constitution is clear: journalism must be independent, not government-approved. This is a win for transparency, accountability, and the American people.

An incredible group of honorees will be recognized by the Congressional Medal of Honor Society this year, including Victor Greenawalt of Minneapolis, who showed extraordinary bravery during the Annunciation school shooting—shielding a classmate and saving his life.

Today, Minnesota stands together — roads lined with red, white, and blue and people coming out to pay tribute to Master Sergeant Nicole Amor. I know it meant a lot to her family as they brought her from her hometown of White Bear Lake to her final resting place at Ft. Snelling.

(Credit: KARE 11)

Video

Heading back to Washington from the beautiful funeral for Master Sgt. Nicole Amor. The roads from White Bear Lake to Ft. Snelling (her final resting place) are lined with Minnesotans paying their respect to Nicole and her wonderful family and friends. 🙏 🇺🇸

It is an honor to attend the memorial service for Master Sergeant Nicole Amor in White Bear Lake today. She was a patriot who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country. She was also a devoted mother, wife, and friend who was clearly a source of light and love in so many lives.

Washington Post headline: Small businesses reeling from tariffs brace for spiking oil prices 
My solutions? 

✅ Stop tariffs that make road kill out of small businesses 

✅ Add more energy to grid & stop bombing everything with no plan 

✅ Make things affordable & easier
